questions.question: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?
questions.definition: to the tip of its antenna
questions.fact: It grew by six metres in 2022, when a new radio antenna went up on top.

questions.question: How many bones are in the human body?
questions.fact: A newborn has more. Many of them fuse as it grows.

questions.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.fact: Two pump blood through the gills, the third through the rest of the body.

questions.question: How many countries are there in Africa?
questions.fact: Algeria is the largest by area, the Seychelles the smallest.

questions.question: How far away is the Moon?
questions.fact: Its light takes about 1.3 seconds to reach us.

questions.question: How many calories are in one gram of fat?
questions.fact: A gram of protein or carbohydrate has about four.

questions.question: How many seconds are there in a day?
questions.fact: Leap seconds have been added now and then to keep clocks in step with the Earth.

questions.question: How high is Mount Everest?
questions.fact: China and Nepal measured it together in 2020.

questions.question: How fast does light travel?
questions.fact: The metre is defined by it: the distance light travels in 1/299,792,458 of a second.

questions.question: How long is a marathon?
questions.fact: The distance was fixed in 1921, after the course of the 1908 London Olympics.

questions.question: How many keys does a standard piano have?
How many countries are members of the United Nations?
questions.fact: South Sudan was the last to join, in 2011.

source.title: Member states of the United Nations
